excluded_population.reason: No matching Task 1/Task 2 training ground truth is present in the supplied source root.

stable_output_order.records: ascending image_id across the two disjoint populations
stable_output_order.task1_findings: one finding object per image in source image_id order after global image_id ordering
stable_output_order.task2_attributes: canonical attribute order: globules, milia_like_cyst, negative_network, pigment_network, streaks
stable_output_order.task3_label_scores: CSV column order: MEL, NV, BCC, AKIEC, BKL, DF, VASC

identity_and_paths.image_path: The exact source-relative JPEG path beneath source_root; no copied image path is introduced.

task1.bbox: Decode the mask and take the tight axis-aligned extent of all nonzero pixels.
task1.bbox_formula: [min_x, min_y, max_x_exclusive, max_y_exclusive] in canonical [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] order
task1.mask_approval: Explicitly approved by the user request to convert task1 segmentation to bbox
task1.all_zero_policy: Fail conversion if encountered; inventory found 0 all-zero Task 1 masks.
task1.all_white_observation: One source mask is all white and therefore maps to the full-image bbox; it is not treated as missing.

task2.attribute_name_derivation: Parse the substring after _attribute_ and before .png; preserve canonical source spelling.
task2.presence_rule: For each mask, present=true when the decoded grayscale maximum is greater than 0; all-black masks map to present=false.
task2.positive_attribute_list: Store only present attribute names in image.annotation.attributes.
task2.explicit_presence_map: Store all five booleans in image.annotation.attribute_presence so black masks are explicit negatives.
task2.source_mask_paths: Store the five exact source-relative mask paths under image.annotation.task2_attribute_mask_paths; paths are provenance only and are not converted to bbox.
task2.bbox: None; Task 2 attribute masks are not converted to bbox.

task3.source: One-hot CSV row joined by image column
task3.diagnosis: The sole active column among MEL, NV, BCC, AKIEC, BKL, DF, VASC, stored as image.annotation.diagnosis.
task3.raw_values: Preserve all seven numeric source values under image.annotation.diagnosis_scores.
task3.bbox: None; Task 3 is diagnosis-only in this mapping.

joins_and_reconciliation.task1_input_to_segmentation: 1000 to 1000, exact image_id match, no missing/orphan/ambiguous rows
joins_and_reconciliation.task1_input_to_attributes: 1000 images to exactly five masks each, no missing/orphan/ambiguous rows
joins_and_reconciliation.task3_input_to_csv: 1512 to 1512, exact image_id match, no missing/orphan/ambiguous rows

excluded_fields_and_sources.patient_case_study: No source-supported scope or identifier is available.
excluded_fields_and_sources.modality_anatomy: No explicit local source field/documentation; kept null.
excluded_fields_and_sources.training_images: Excluded because corresponding ground truth is absent.
excluded_fields_and_sources.archive_duplicates: Not read as separate populations because extracted copies are present.

image_handling.user_requirement: Copy the original ISIC JPEG bytes into the normalized artifact and preserve their color/pixel encoding.
image_handling.observed_referenced_format: 2512 RGB JPEG source images; Task 1-2 dimensions vary across 114 sizes and Task 3 is 600x450.
image_handling.proposed_action: Keep image.image_path pointing to source-relative JPEGs for annotation construction and copy each referenced JPEG byte-for-byte to <artifact_dir>/images/<image_id>.jpg.
image_handling.spatial_policy: Preserve original source dimensions; no resize, crop, rotation, flip, or other spatial transform.
image_handling.manifest_layout: image_manifest.jsonl beside annotation.jsonl; legacy png_path values use images/<image_id>.jpg for backward compatibility.
image_handling.prepare_medical_images_note: The generated image script follows the skill's annotation-order, staging, safe-relative-path, hash, and idempotent-publish rules, with the user-approved JPEG-preservation policy for this dataset.
image_handling.downstream_risk: The evaluation loader has been minimally extended to accept PNG and JPEG assets while retaining the legacy manifest key. Existing PNG datasets remain supported.
